title: Layla Reader
description:
Turn your books into audio with Layla Reader. Drop in a document and Layla extracts the text, splits it into passages, voices each one, and reads the whole thing aloud in order.

Features:
- Import your books: Drop in a TXT, PDF, or EPUB and Layla extracts the text right in the app.
- Split into passages: The book is chunked into readable passages, each becoming its own audio clip.
- Pre-generate narration: Every passage is voiced to a saved audio file up front using Layla's text-to-speech.
- Listen straight through: Play the book as a queue with full transport controls — play, pause, skip, and jump to any passage.
